info.title: LILITH by THE MIDDLE API
info.description:
Generated from the zod schemas of `packages/contracts` (Blueprint v1.0 §18). Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm contracts:openapi`.

Money is a whole number of satang with `currency` THB, never a float. Date-times are RFC 3339 in UTC; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Lists use cursor pagination: `{ data, next_cursor }`. Every non-2xx response is the error envelope.

DateOnly.description: Calendar date without a time, YYYY-MM-DD.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Body of every non-2xx response. Some codes add members beside `code`, for example `allowed_from_here`.

OpaqueId.description: An opaque identifier. Blueprint v1.0 shows no prefix for this kind of id.

PositiveSatang.description: Amount in satang, greater than zero.

PropertyPatchBody.description: Any subset of the wizard fields. Blueprint v1.0 does not list them.

PropertyPrivateDTO.description: The listing as its owner, its listing agent and admins see it.

PropertyPublicDTO.description: A listing as any authenticated T2 user may see it. It never carries the address line, the unit number, the exact coordinates, the owner's identity or contact, or documents.

RequirementPatchBody.description: Any subset of the wizard fields. Blueprint v1.0 does not list them.

Satang.description: Amount of money in satang (100 satang = 1 baht). A whole number, never a float.

TimelineItem.description: A timeline entry: a transition, message, viewing or offer. Blueprint v1.0 does not give its shape.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, ending in Z.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A UUID naming this request. Sending the same key again returns the first response instead of repeating the action.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: A UUID naming this request; required for offers, transitions and payments. Sending the same key again returns the first response instead of repeating the action.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `version` the client last read, in quotes, for example `"3"`. A mismatch answers 409 CONFLICT_VERSION.

RequestId.description: Id of this request. Clients show it on error screens; it matches `error.request_id`.
